MY HARVEST HUB PLATFORM BUG & FEATURE 
IMPROVEMENT REPORT – (22-10-2025) 
1. Vendor Category Issue 
Description: New vendors unable to categorize their store or brand during registration 
or profile setup. The platform currently provides product and service categories, but 
there is no dedicated field or option for a vendor’s brand type. 
Expected: Vendors should be able to select or create a suitable category that best 
represents their brand or business type during onboarding. 
Impact: Vendors’ stores appear uncategorized, reducing proper sorting, filtering, and 
discoverability on the platform. 
2. WhatsApp Number Automation 
Description: When vendors add their WhatsApp contact during profile setup, they are 
required to manually input the full number including the country code (+234). 
Expected: The system should automatically prefill the Nigerian country code “+234” 
before the input field, so vendors only need to enter the remaining digits of their 
number. 
Impact: Improves user experience, prevents formatting errors, and ensures contact 
consistency across all vendor profiles. 
3. Delayed Password Reset Email  
Description: When a vendor requests a password reset, the reset link sent to their email 
is delayed. Vendors experience a long waiting period (several minutes) before receiving 
the reset email. 
Expected: The password reset link should be delivered promptly (within Seconds) after 
the request is made. 
Impact: Causes frustration and delays in account recovery for vendors, potentially 
discouraging platform use. 
4. Campus/Location Selection Update 
Description: During new vendor registration, there is currently an option for vendors to 
indicate their campus location (e.g., the church campus they attend). However, the 
selection is limited and does not account for vendors who are outside Lagos. 
Expected: The system should allow vendors to: 
a. Select the campus closest to them from a dropdown list. 
b. Indicate whether they are based within Lagos or outside Lagos. 
Impact: Improves location accuracy, helps better organize vendors by region, and 
enhances logistics or vendor sorting. 
5. Pickup or Delivery Option for Customers  
Description: Currently, users can select delivery dates and time frames, but there is no 
option to indicate whether they prefer to pick up their orders. 
Expected: Customers should be able to choose between: 
a. Pickup in church (with options like “Midweek Service or “Sunday Service”) 
b. Home Delivery (doorstep at the address provided) 
Impact: Enhances delivery flexibility and convenience, reduces confusion on logistics, 
and supports organized distribution during services or events.
